flow.stepDescription: Talk with Tighnari as you wait for the results

dialogs.text: Kolu...
Who knew that I'd encounter a mechanical life form in this manner after a hundred years?
I didn't know mechanical life forms could get sick, too... You have to get better soon, Karkata!

flow.stepDescription: Go to the northeast of Hypostyle Desert

dialogs.text: A "Fully Automated Irrigation System"... That's quite the task.
Master, can I help with anything at all? I can go buy things, prepare pen and paper...
Oh, you know, I seem to remember that you have a lot of homework today.
Huh? O—Oh, yeah, I do...
Well, hurry up and finish it so you can sleep early, or Faruzan will worry. That's the best thing you can do now to help.
Oh... Okay...
Kolu...
Ugh... So we still can't go back to Aaru Village?
Just what are they digging for?
That huge machine looks amazing!
Ugh... So we still can't go back to Aaru Village?
Just what are they digging for?
That huge machine looks amazing!
The ruins? Don't know anything. We were only hired to deliver water and supplies to them.
Forget excavation — they won't even let us get close to the camp where they're staying.
This area used to be ravaged by frequent sandstorms, but it's been calm lately for some reason...
They say that this was done by a single traveler? But seriously, is such a thing even humanly possible?
That machine looks amazing! Could it be the legendary Ruin Wanderer?
The location seems to fit too... Might that legend actually be true?
Halt! Mr. Raed's permission is required to proceed any further!

flow.stepDescription: Organize the gathered information with Faruzan

dialogs.text: Halt! Mr. Raed's permission is required to proceed any further!
Halt! Mr. Raed's permission is required to proceed any further!
There's a tent that the villagers occasionally use to rest. Like I said, it's a bit simple, yes, but I hope you won't mind.
Halt! Mr. Raed's permission is required to proceed any further!
Ah, sorry for disturbing your rest. I'll tell my subordinates to be quieter in the future.
(The wreckage of the huge machine remains motionless...)
"...Tamimi's remodeling is going smoothly. As it is now, it can learn how to deal with various dangerous situations in the ruins on its own. I wish you could see it with your own eyes."
"As I worked, I kept thinking that you'd do a better job at this than I could."
"After all, you're the most exceptional student I've ever met."
"Dear Madam Faruzan..."
"The notes and manuscripts we found on Tamimi have been transcribed and organized, and every one of them has been marked with your name."
"I hope that even after a hundred years, future generations of students will still remember your name, Madam Faruzan."
"... I told you not to... Now, look... So many people... Worried... Even... Tamimi..."
(The messy scribbling has been repeatedly canceled and edited, leaving barely legible phrases and a single neat message at the back.)
"Hurry up and come home for a meal. Your mom always makes an extra portion of food, you know?"
(Faruzan's head hangs low in silence... The desert breathes gales of wind, and the only sound that can be heard is the scattering rise of spreading grains.)

Kalu! Kalu!
It looks fine, but even so, it needs to properly rest up.
Faruzan went out after repairing Karkata. She seems to be looking for you for some reason.
...Well, I will not probe any further. However, if you need any help, do feel free to ask.
Kolu...
